2 Days Ol Pejeta Safari

Package overview

Ol Pejeta Conservancy is one of Kenya’s top wildlife destinations, renowned for its rich biodiversity and conservation success. Home to the Big Five—lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, and buffalo—Ol Pejeta also hosts endangered species like the northern white rhino. Visitors can enjoy game drives, chimpanzee sanctuaries, and scenic views of the Laikipia Plateau. This 2-day safari offers an intimate wildlife experience without the rush, ideal for nature lovers and photographers.

  • Ol Pejeta Conservancy
  • The Last Northern White Rhinos: The most poignant highlight is visiting Najin and Fatu, the last two remaining northern white rhinos in the world, a truly once-in-a-lifetime encounter that underscores the importance of global conservation efforts.
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Ol Pejeta is East Africa's largest black rhino sanctuary, with a robust and growing population of over 100 individuals, offering excellent opportunities to see these endangered animals in their natural habitat
  • The "Big Five": The conservancy is home to all members of the Big Five: elephant, lion, leopard, buffalo, and rhino. Its high wildlife-to-land ratio makes sightings of these iconic species fairly common.
  • Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary : This is the only place in Kenya where you can see chimpanzees. The sanctuary provides a lifelong refuge for chimps rescued from various traumatic situations across Africa, in an agreement with the Jane Goodall Institute.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi – Ol Pejeta Conservancy

Morning: Pickup from Nairobi in a 4×4 safari vehicle. Depart Nairobi for Ol Pejeta Conservancy (approx. 4–5 hours’ drive). Stop en route for refreshments and scenic photos. Afternoon: Arrival at your lodge/camp in Ol Pejeta. Check-in and lunch. Afternoon game drive in the conservancy—spot elephants, lions, zebras, giraffes, and rhinos. Evening: Return to the lodge for dinner. Optional night game drive (depending on lodge availability). Overnight at the lodge/camp.

02Day 2 | Ol Pejeta – Nairobi

Early Morning: Optional early morning game drive to catch predators and active wildlife. Visit the Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary , home to rescued chimpanzees. Mid-Morning: Return to the lodge for breakfast. Leisure time to enjoy lodge facilities or take short nature walks. Late Morning – Early Afternoon: Check out and begin the drive back to Nairobi. Stop for lunch en route (picnic or lodge depending on arrangement). Afternoon: Arrive in Nairobi and drop-off at your hotel or airport. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.
